input_zh: 基于权威 main 提交 5f8704a48ab8bbddf29b02867c9d6a4b5b57b475 中的 Scheduler V3.0 与 Worker Control V1.3.0，使用 branch=main、wake-source=chatgpt-scheduled-task、2026-08-18 有效 Reading 时段，以及当前 Worker 实际具备的 GitHub 读写、文件编辑与 Web Research 能力，完成 Reading 的 Fail-closed Admission。确定性核验生成版 Reading Prompt research/runtime/worker-prompts/generated/reading.prompt.md v1.0.0 的 SHA-256 为 9ad93d7f4cd7859fc0b32fa9b3b9e2b836a177c889addcc67d0b4fdc3261d7b5，并从该固定控制提交完整读取全部五个 Required Source。随后将同日 Wake Receipt research/runtime/wakes/2026/08/2026-08-18/reading-110050.json 持久提交并重新 Fetch 核验。仓库 Reconciliation 确认 Discovery 与 Queue 已持久 Completed，把 Reading 判定为最早到期未收口任务并授予执行权，打开 Execution Slot；Worker Claimed 状态随后在 main 提交 8dc3b4411b53ffce72d900e2dcf3c9905b59b7b7 上完成持久核验。Reading 仅消费同日 Research Plan 中的 Q-20260818-01、Q-20260818-02、Q-20260818-03 及其三个维护者一手合并提交。未把前一日 Reading Result 或 Research Object 作为当天输入。
workResult: Completed Skill 03 source-complete Deep Reading for all three same-date selected objects after ordered Runtime authority and Worker Claimed were durably established. Q-20260818-01 verified that Google ADK now always marks A2A-originated invocations, including requests whose peer metadata is empty or absent, and that the changed tool-confirmation processor returns before resolving confirmation events when that A2A marker is present; regression tests cover both metadata-present and no-metadata cases, blocking the demonstrated remote-peer self-approval path without proving complete HITL security. Q-20260818-02 verified a SQLite-backed durable queue wakeup architecture: PRAGMA data_version detects cross-connection change, durable per-thread revisions identify affected loaded queues and are backfilled/updated across insert, update and delete, newly loaded/resumed threads are reconciled separately, and per-thread 10-second retry tasks allow one blocked wake to retry without stalling unrelated queues; this is not distributed exactly-once execution. Q-20260818-03 verified an exec-server observability boundary in which the inbound request span and queue timestamp are created at connection-queue receipt, optional W3C parent context is validated, the same span survives server/client queues and route execution, queue latency is emitted only after admission with a bounded route label, and terminal operational outcomes including error/disconnect are recorded; this does not prove complete causal tracing or external-side-effect rollback. Three durable Reading Notes were produced. No Research Analysis, article drafting, visualization or publication was performed.
workResult_zh: 仅在有序 Runtime 执行权与 Worker Claimed 均完成持久核验后，才对三个同日已选对象完成 Skill 03 Source-complete Deep Reading。Q-20260818-01 核验了 Google ADK 现在始终标记 A2A 来源的 Invocation，即使远端 Metadata 为空或缺失也保留 A2A Marker；变更后的工具确认处理器一旦检测到该 Marker，就会在解析确认事件之前直接返回。回归测试同时覆盖有 Metadata 与无 Metadata 两种情况，阻断已证明的远程对端自我审批路径，但不能扩大解释为完整 HITL 安全。Q-20260818-02 核验了基于 SQLite 的持久队列唤醒架构：PRAGMA data_version 用于发现跨连接变化，持久 Thread Revision 用于定位受影响的已加载队列，并在 Insert、Update、Delete 时更新且对旧队列迁移回填；新加载/恢复 Thread 另行 Reconcile；每个 Thread 拥有独立的固定 10 秒重试任务，使单个阻塞 Wake 不拖住无关队列。该机制不等于分布式 Exactly-once。Q-20260818-03 核验了 Exec-server 请求可观测边界：请求进入 Connection Queue 时即创建 Inbound Span 与排队时间戳，可选 W3C Parent Context 会先验证；同一 Span 贯穿 Server/Client Queue 与 Route Execution；Queue Latency 仅在 Admission 之后按有界 Route Label 记录；Error/Disconnect 等终态会被记录。该机制不能扩大解释为完整因果追踪或外部副作用回滚。共形成 3 份持久 Reading Note。未执行 Research Analysis、文章写作、可视化或发布。
